summary: Kanzhun Limited filed a Form 6-K on August 25, 2026, announcing its interim results for the six months ended June 30, 2026. The filing is a routine earnings announcement by a foreign private issuer and contains no special-situation elements such as mergers, acquisitions, tender offers, or restructuring. The document is accompanied by an exhibit containing the interim results announcement. No transaction terms, premiums, or board recommendations are present. This is a standard periodic disclosure with no impact on event-driven investment analysis.
